title: Elmira Pleasure Ground; learning scales by listening
summary: He recalls the Elmira Pleasure Ground in Algiers and peeping through the fence to hear the band until a policeman chased him.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: I'm going to ask about the Elmira Pleasure Ground. You mentioned the picnics you had down where you were living. Where was the Elmira Pleasure Ground?
In Algiers, the Elmira Pleasure Ground. That's in the back. It was in the back, uh, had a little fence all around Elmira.
Was it near the river or near where the SP station was?

Where was the SP station? Right in the back there. Of course I was back there peeping through the fence and listening at the band and I was peeping through the fence and the policeman come back there and he hit me up.
Did you run in the middle of the band?
Yeah, I was peeping through the band like that. I was peeping through the back, and bam!
I looked at the band, the people dancing today. Listening to the music. Yeah, listening to the music. You weren't hurting everybody. Yeah, Elmira Pleasure Ground.
You wouldn't remember what band that was in the world?
No, no, I wouldn't remember what band that was.

Yeah, they were dancing that night. But that's been quite a while. It must have been quite a while. Yeah, that's been quite a while. I was kind of a young fellow then, you know what I mean? Just stood by me. Anyway, I hear a band, I would go listen at them, try to catch them. Yeah. The best thing I would grab it.

You see, when you're doing music, you can get any instrument on you want to scale. Is that right? Yeah. Any instrument knows you want to scale after you know that music now. Get the scale of your instrument, well you see, you ain't got nothing to worry about the
You know the time and the counting.
Yeah, you ain't got nothing to worry about.
